children: Analysts lowered their 2026 economic growth forecast for Argentina while raising inflation expectations, a central bank survey showed on Friday.
They now expect economic growth to close 2026 at 2.1%, down 0.6 percentage points from their previous estimate.
Inflation is projected to end the year at 30.0%, according to the median forecast, up 0.21 percentage points from the prior estimate.
